cohort_summary: Ten professional prop bettors ($20k-$500k). All value the per-PA x xPA decomposition, lineup-slot awareness, transparent BASE/SAMPLE labels, filterable/exportable board. None can complete the core sharp loop (model fair vs best price -> edge -> bet -> CLV) inside the app: no prop prices, fair odds, edge sort, or bet log; LIFT vs league is not a value signal. Pitcher props use generic fixed lines (every SP O5.5 Ks / O16.5 outs) with no ladder, which fails K/outs specialists outright. Early-line bettors lack tomorrow's slate and lineup-post alerts. Power users want a dense multi-market grid and ID-keyed CSV/API. Trust is weakened by small-sample calibration tiles, fixture Data Feed and ungraded pitcher props. Task success: full 0, partial 6, failed 4.

pain_points.evidence: desk__pred: columns are P(1+ HIT)/LIFT/WHY/REST OF GAME only; pitchhawk.js:1017-1030 CSV has no price/line fields; brief: /edge exists only for game markets
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add per-row best price across books (+ book name), no-vig consensus, model fair odds (American) and EV%/edge; sort by edge, not lift.

delights: Honest 'BASE' tagging and 'SAMPLE DATA' banner — appreciates transparency

personas.name: Grace Nakamura
personas.profile: Pro-adjacent part-timer; $60k bankroll, $500 units; DK, FD, BetMGM, Novig; markets: 1+ hit and HR; uses a 14" laptop at lunch
personas.goal: 20-minute lunch session: 3 high-confidence hit props with good price and a stake suggestion
journey: Home: LIVE DECISIONS cards are about win prob/next pitch — not her use case; scrolls
Game cards show 'STRONGEST READ' HR per game — nice discovery
Predictions 1+ Hit; picks top 3 by lift; no price, no EV
Wants suggested stake at 1/4 Kelly — nothing
Places bets based on her own book check; leaves with picks but unsure of edge
personas.quote: It found me names quickly — but whether they're worth betting is still all on me.

pain_points.title: Ranking by LIFT over league rate is not a value signal
pain_points.detail: Lift ranking surfaces players whose books already price the edge.
pain_points.evidence: desk__pred header 'ranked by lift over the league rate'; PRED_DEFAULTS pSort:'lift' pitchhawk.js:870
pain_points.suggested_fix: Offer 'Edge vs market' as default sort when odds exist; demote lift to a context column.

pain_points.title: No stake sizing given bankroll and edge
pain_points.detail: No staking help.
pain_points.evidence: No bankroll or stake settings
pain_points.suggested_fix: Optional bankroll setting, fractional-Kelly stake suggestion per edge row.

pain_points.title: Home hero is live win-prob/next-pitch; pregame prop discovery is below the fold
pain_points.detail: For a pregame prop bettor the first screen is irrelevant live-game content; she scrolls past it every visit.
pain_points.evidence: desk__home LIVE DECISIONS block first
pain_points.suggested_fix: Let users pin a 'Top props value' module above live cards.

pain_points.title: At laptop widths the WHY column truncates ('Guerrero allows ...') and the wide board needs horizontal effort
pain_points.detail: Laptop truncation of WHY.
pain_points.evidence: desk__pred.png WHY cells end in ellipsis even at 1440
pain_points.suggested_fix: Wrap or tooltip WHY; responsive column priority for 1280-1366 widths.

top_cohort_issues.title: No book line, price, implied prob or edge on any player prop
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add per-row best price across books (+ book name), no-vig consensus, model fair odds (American) and EV%/edge; sort by edge, not lift.

top_cohort_issues.title: Ranking by LIFT over league rate is not a value signal
top_cohort_issues.fix: Offer 'Edge vs market' as default sort when odds exist; demote lift to a context column.

top_cohort_issues.title: Calibration tiles sit atop the board showing large landed-vs-predicted gaps with tiny samples, and Data Feed is SAMPLE DATA
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show reliability with confidence intervals, longer windows by default, Brier/log-loss vs market closing price; hide tiles below a min sample.

top_cohort_issues.title: Pitcher K/Outs/H/ER/BB lines are generic (every SP O5.5 Ks, O16.5 outs) and not editable
top_cohort_issues.fix: Expose full distribution (P(over) at every half-line, or ladder), let user type the book line/price, and default the line to the market's posted number.

top_cohort_issues.title: No way to log a bet (book, price, stake) or track results
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'Log bet' on each row (book, price, stake, time) feeding a bet tracker with CLV and ROI.

top_cohort_issues.title: No open/close prices or line history, so CLV cannot be measured
top_cohort_issues.fix: Store open/current/close per prop per book; show movement sparkline and grade model/pick CLV in Data Feed.

top_cohort_issues.title: Total bases only visible after expanding a row; cannot rank/filter/export TB
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add TB chip with lines 0.5/1.5/2.5 and include in CSV.

top_cohort_issues.title: CSV export lacks player/game IDs, timestamps, opposing hand, and any line/price columns
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add mlbam player_id, game_pk, model_ts, phase, opp_hand, all markets in one wide file, and an API/JSON endpoint with token auth.

top_cohort_issues.title: Starters tab has no lift, no min-lift filter, no sort by K over-prob, and form columns empty
top_cohort_issues.fix: Sortable columns per prop, lift/edge per prop, populated K%/whiff/CSW, opposing lineup K% vs hand.

top_cohort_issues.title: Can't see when/why a probability moved (timestamp only 'updated 5:06 PM')
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add per-row prob history (open model value, lineup-adjusted, weather-adjusted) with deltas and reasons.

top_cohort_issues.title: At laptop widths the WHY column truncates ('Guerrero allows ...') and the wide board needs horizontal effort
top_cohort_issues.fix: Wrap or tooltip WHY; responsive column priority for 1280-1366 widths.

top_cohort_issues.title: Early (pre-lineup) reads show 'slot pending' with no assumed slot/PA or lineup-change alert
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show assumed slot + probability of starting, and push an alert/diff when a lineup posts and the prob moves > X pts.
